verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry and CLI, a kind of product that could plausibly ship official programmatic SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only CLI commands (add, use, list, update, init) and the SKILL.md spec, and a community user even requests a REST API. No official SDK or programmatic library is evidenced, and the CLI is an adjacent interface, not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
